This owner shows the same class of register-allocation nondeterminism (a hi-register role swap between two long-lived, similarly-referenced pseudos) already documented for the structurally adjacent shop-family owner 080b211c (fp/r9 swap) -- cross-owner evidence this is a shared compiler sensitivity for this idiom rather than a defect in this specific source shape.
